input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果这把花对你的身体好：这朵花对身体好不好，An embedded yes/no question cannot use 如果; use an A-not-A form such as 好不好. Also, a single flower takes the classifier 朵, while 一把花 refers to a bunch of flowers.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 如果这把花毒不毒：这朵花有没有毒，After 看, an embedded yes/no question uses A-not-A or 有没有, not 如果. Use 有毒 to describe a poisonous plant.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：自己吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When choosing between two possibilities, use 是……还是…… rather than an A-not-A question followed by 或者. 自己 also clearly shows that the person who ate the plant is 神农.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这很麻烦：找别的植物很麻烦，The demonstrative 这 has a vague referent here; repeat the action with a noun phrase so the reader knows exactly what is difficult.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他一吃花：他一吃那朵花，The noun 花 is unclear because more than one flower has been mentioned. Use a demonstrative plus classifier to identify the flower being eaten.

items.reason: 如果 cannot introduce the embedded yes/no question here, and 这朵花对身体好不好 is a correct replacement.
看后的嵌入式是非问句不能用如果， 有没有毒 correctly expresses the intended question.
The intended meaning is whether Shennong should eat it, so 要不要吃 is needed; the proposed correction instead asks which plant he already ate.
这 naturally refers to the immediately preceding action of looking for other plants, so it is not too vague here.
Because more than one flower has been mentioned, bare 花 does not clearly identify the flower he ate; 那朵花 makes the reference clear.
